headline: A 2019 law renames the Hobe Sound National Wildlife Refuge in Florida after conservationist Nathaniel P. Reed.
what_it_does: The law changes the official name of the Hobe Sound National Wildlife Refuge in Florida to the Nathaniel P. Reed Hobe Sound National Wildlife Refuge. The official summary describes only this renaming. It does not describe any change to the refuge's boundaries, rules, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 10, 2019, and the new name applies from that date.
